findings.passage: I am fairly happy with the voting practices in the State of Tennessee. We don’t use drop boxes, photo ID is required, and mail-in ballots are heavily regulated.
findings.note: Candidate questionnaire answer (2022 general-election profile) to 'What laws would you propose to change present voting practices?'. Says he is content with current Tennessee practices and names photo ID, no drop boxes and regulated mail-in ballots.

findings.passage: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree
findings.note: Candidate questionnaire: gave the answer 'Strongly Disagree' to the statement that people should be able to vote without photo identification. Questionnaire statement plus his answer, same 2022 profile.
